title: [Audit] Kibana request → Elasticsearch requests
description: Each Kibana request beside the Elasticsearch requests it made, newest first. Narrow the time range first, then Filter for value on a Kibana request to follow one; a pinned request id filter would hide the Elasticsearch side.
esql: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE service.name == "serverless-kibana" OR `http.request.header.x-opaque-id` LIKE "*;kibana:*" OR `http.request.header.x-opaque-id` RLIKE "[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}" | EVAL kibana_request = CASE(service.name == "serverless-kibana", http.request.id, MV_FIRST(SPLIT(`http.request.header.x-opaque-id`, ";"))) | SORT @timestamp DESC | EVAL actor = CASE(user.email IS NOT NULL, user.email, api_key.name IS NOT NULL, api_key.name, user.domain == "_cloud_api_key", CONCAT(user.name, " · Cloud API key"), user.domain == "_es_api_key", CONCAT("Unnamed key of ", user.name), user.name IS NOT NULL, user.name, "(unattributed)") | EVAL identity_kind = CASE(user.email IS NOT NULL, "Person", api_key.name IS NOT NULL, "Elasticsearch API key", user.domain == "_es_api_key", "Unnamed API key", user.domain == "_cloud_api_key", "Cloud API key", user.domain == "_service_account", "Service account", event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied"), "Failed sign-in", user.name IS NULL, "Unattributed", "Other") | EVAL source = CASE(service.name == "serverless-elasticsearch", "Elasticsearch", service.name == "serverless-kibana", "Kibana", service.name), path = REPLACE(url.original, "^https?://[^/]+", ""), obj = COALESCE(kibana.saved_object.name, kibana.saved_object.id), result = CASE(event.outcome == "unknown", "attempted", event.outcome), caller = REPLACE(`http.request.header.x-opaque-id`, "^[^;]*;", "") | EVAL request = CASE(elasticsearch.audit.action IS NOT NULL, elasticsearch.audit.action, kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(kibana.saved_object.type, ": ", COALESCE(obj, "(no id)")), path IS NOT NULL, path, event.action LIKE "saved_object_*", "(objects not recorded)", "(not recorded)") | KEEP @timestamp, kibana_request, source, actor, identity_kind, event.action, request, result, caller | EVAL actor = REPLACE(REPLACE(actor, "^([-_A-Za-z0-9]{5})[-_A-Za-z0-9]{15} · Cloud API key$", "$1… · Cloud API key"), "^Unnamed key of ([-_A-Za-z0-9]{5})[-_A-Za-z0-9]{15}$", "Unnamed key of $1…") | RENAME @timestamp AS Time, kibana_request AS `Kibana request`, source AS Source, actor AS Identity, identity_kind AS `Identity type`, event.action AS Action, request AS Request, result AS Outcome, caller AS Caller
